status: assistant extraction and applicability proposal; not SME-reviewed
reading_depth: USGS publication abstract; ScienceBase release description, FGDC metadata and both CSVs. Publisher full text inaccessible; analysis not reproduced.

chain.record: Compare survival and growth among species, years and mussel-density patches.
West Newton Chute, Pool 5; tagging in 2012 and annual recoveries in 2013–2016. This is not Steamboat Island.
Historical density defined core/periphery polygons; five 5 × 5 m plots per polygon. Tagged mussels were allocated among plots. Density habitats were not randomly imposed restoration treatments.
chain.locator: Data-release description, IDW quartiles and plot allocation
chain.basis: Source description plus analyst inference limit

chain.record: PIT identity, recovery, live/dead status and shell length were recorded repeatedly. Plot visits retain dates, depth and search effort.
chain.locator: FGDC eainfo/detailed attribute definitions; tracking data.csv and plot data.csv headers

chain.record: Two inspected CSVs: 569 individual records and 100 plot-visit rows. These are file counts, not independently estimated survival rates.

Published survival and growth comparisons are identified, but fitted models, detection assumptions, exclusions and uncertainty estimates remain unverified. The inspected release lists metadata and two CSVs, with no analysis-code attachment.
chain.locator: Publication abstract §§3–4; ScienceBase JSON files list

chain.record: Authors report higher survival in core habitat and variation among species and years.
Authors report species and age differences, without a significant core/periphery growth difference.
Authors infer the importance of substrate stability; their core/periphery source–sink explanation requires further recruitment-source testing.

SC-03 informs formulation of SC-08. Compare local substrate dynamics, flows, species and sampling design before transferring the interpretation. No Steamboat treatment effect or numerical criterion follows from this study alone.
chain.locator: SC-03 → SC-08; Steamboat feasibility VI-1 and X-4 footnote 8

review_flags: Publication/release narrative says 578 tagged mussels; the inspected tracking file has 569 unique individual IDs and the plot file sums to 576 placed in 2012. Reconcile cohort accounting before analysis; do not silently replace any source total.
CSV taxon label Quadrula pustulosa differs from Cyclonaias pustulosa in the abstract. Preserve both original labels; obtain an explicit taxonomic mapping before joining.
Not located, missing '.', recorded dead and carried-forward status must remain distinguishable. A missing recovery is not automatically mortality.

The abstract includes an apparently inconsistent directional statement about survival versus substrate stability. Resolve the metric and sign in full methods/results before encoding a quantitative relationship.
No local restoration feature, adopted hypothesis, post-construction observation or empirical support edge has been established by this extraction.
